sentences.source: 这既不是有事情要发生的前兆，也并不是什么非日常的光景。
sentences.translation: This was neither an omen of something about to happen nor some extraordinary sight.

sentences.source: 要说和平时有什么差别的话，也就是下午的烈日中，在从大学下课回家的路上看到穿着母校校服的男生女生。
sentences.translation: If anything was different from usual, it was that, beneath the blazing afternoon sun on my way home from university, I happened to see a group of boys and girls wearing the uniform of my old high school.

sentences.source: 这两个男生和两个女生愉快地聊着天，大概他们是同一个社团的吧。
sentences.translation: The two boys and two girls chatted merrily together; they were probably in the same club.

sentences.source: 这副光景对我这个精英落单的学生有点耀眼。
sentences.translation: The sight was a little too dazzling for an elite loner like me.

sentences.source: 尤其是两位女生班花级别的可爱，让我对旁边一起走着的男生心生羡慕。
sentences.translation: The two girls in particular were cute enough to be class idols, which made me envious of the boys walking beside them.

sentences.source: 男女比正好是二比二，说不定是两对情侣…… 现充爆炸了该多好……
sentences.translation: With an even split of two boys and two girls, maybe they were two couples…… If only those normies would just explode……

sentences.source: 回家的路上一切都好好的。
sentences.translation: Everything had been perfectly normal on my way home.

sentences.source: 直到四个人被红灯拦下，我站在他们数步之后──脚底下出现了奇怪的魔法阵──
sentences.translation: That is, until a red light stopped the four of them and, as I stood a few paces behind──a strange magic circle appeared beneath our feet──

sentences.source: 还没反应过来，眼前的景色产生一片杂讯，周围的风景一下子变了个样。
sentences.translation: Before I could react, my vision dissolved into static, and the scenery around me changed in an instant.

sentences.source: 原本是沥青的地面变成了石头，明媚到烦人的阳光变成了暗淡的油灯（？）光…… 等等，有点莫名其妙。
sentences.translation: The asphalt beneath me had become stone, and the obnoxiously bright sunlight had turned into the dim glow of an oil lamp（？）…… Wait, none of this makes any sense.

sentences.source: 「欢迎你们的到来，『勇者殿下』」
sentences.translation: 「Welcome, 『Yūsha-sama』」

sentences.source: 耳朵还没适应当前的状况，就听见后面传来铃铛一样清澈的声音。
sentences.translation: Before my ears had even adjusted to the situation, a voice as clear as a ringing bell came from behind me.

sentences.source: 回头一看，后面站着一位身着白净无暇的连衣裙，金发碧眼的美女，以及先前见到的四人组…… 中的两位高中女生和一位高中男生。
sentences.translation: When I turned around, I found a beautiful blonde-haired, blue-eyed woman in a spotless white dress standing behind me, along with…… two of the high school girls and one of the high school boys from the group of four I had seen earlier.

sentences.source: 哎？
sentences.translation: Huh？

sentences.source: 是不是少了一个人？
sentences.translation: Aren’t we missing someone？

sentences.source: 「事发突然，想必你们──诶？」
sentences.translation: 「I realize this is quite sudden, and you must be──huh？」

sentences.source: 金发美女看着我们，露出让人不禁出神的微笑，开口…… 把话说到一半停了下来。
sentences.translation: The blonde beauty looked at us and began speaking with an enchanting smile…… only to stop halfway through.

sentences.source: 之后是沉默…… 被放置在一旁的我和三位高中生自不用说，欲言又止的美女和周围一些穿着长袍的人们也仿佛时间静止一样一动不动。
sentences.translation: Silence followed…… Not only were the three high schoolers and I left hanging, but the beauty who had trailed off and the robed people around her also stood utterly still, as though time itself had stopped.

sentences.source: 现场笼罩着一片寂静。
sentences.translation: A hush settled over the room.

sentences.source: 「…… 啊，那个，大小姐？
sentences.translation: 「…… Um, Ojō-sama？

sentences.source: 我好像看到有四个人？」
sentences.translation: I believe I see four people？」

sentences.source: 「…… 巧了露娜，我也看到了四个人」
sentences.translation: 「…… What a coincidence, Luna; I see four people too」

sentences.source: 其中一位穿着长袍的人仿佛下定决心一样向美女说话，美女也有点困惑地回答了。
sentences.translation: One of the robed figures finally seemed to make up her mind and addressed the beauty, who answered with some confusion of her own.

sentences.source: 遗憾的是我的思考还没跟上仿佛轮摆式移位一样打过来的非日常。
sentences.translation: Unfortunately, my thoughts still couldn’t keep up with the extraordinary situation pummeling me like a Dempsey Roll.

sentences.source: 如果我是电脑的话，现在鼠标指标已经变成沙漏了吧。
sentences.translation: If I were a computer, my mouse pointer would have turned into an hourglass by now.

sentences.source: 应该用 Intel 处理器的…… 不不，我在想什么啊？
sentences.translation: I should’ve gone with an Intel processor…… No, wait, what am I even thinking about？

sentences.source: 看了一眼同样境遇的三名高中生，他们大概也是和我一样的状态，瞄了我一眼之后露出了困惑的表情。
sentences.translation: I glanced at the three high schoolers who had been thrown into the same predicament, and they seemed just as lost as I was, giving me puzzled looks in return.

sentences.source: 「这是那个吧！
sentences.translation: 「This is that thing, isn’t it！

sentences.source: 把三个人卷入了『召唤』，就是这种事情吧！？」
sentences.translation: Three extra people got caught up in the 『summoning』—that’s what happened, right！？」

sentences.source: 「嗯，大概是吧…… 怎么办，大小姐？」
sentences.translation: 「Yes, most likely…… What should we do, Ojō-sama？」

sentences.source: 「不管怎么说也不能一句『哎哟失败了，哎嘿』打发了事，总之先跟所有人说明情况…… 啊，不过至少先要判别谁是勇者殿下……」
sentences.translation: 「Whatever we do, we can’t just brush it off with an 『Oops, we messed up—eheh』, so let’s explain the situation to everyone first…… Ah, but before that, we at least need to determine which one is Yūsha-sama……」

sentences.source: 「哎嘿什么的…… 大小姐，你这个年龄是不是太装嫩了……」
sentences.translation: 「『Eheh』…… Ojō-sama, aren’t you a little old to be acting cute……？」

sentences.source: 「为什么要在这里冷静地吐槽！？」
sentences.translation: 「Why are you calmly throwing in a tsukkomi at a time like this！？」

sentences.source: 这个残念的对话是什么啊。
sentences.translation: What was with this disappointingly goofy exchange？

sentences.source: 感觉对未知状况的危机感正被一点一点地削去…… 两个高中女生也是一脸惊呆的表情，男生──为什么要握紧拳头摆姿势？
sentences.translation: I could feel my sense of danger toward this unknown situation being chipped away bit by bit…… The two high school girls looked dumbfounded too, while the boy──why was he clenching his fist and striking a pose？

sentences.source: 在这种状况下，摆姿势？
sentences.translation: A pose, in a situation like this？

sentences.source: 嗯？
sentences.translation: Hm？

sentences.source: 等等…… 勇者殿下？
sentences.translation: Wait…… Yūsha-sama？

sentences.source: 召唤？
sentences.translation: Summoning？

sentences.source: 卷入？
sentences.translation: Caught up in it？

sentences.source: 感觉好像听到了一些很耳熟的单词。
sentences.translation: I felt like I had heard some very familiar words.

sentences.source: 仔细想想，好像最近有类似的──
sentences.translation: Come to think of it, I had encountered something like this recently──

sentences.source: 「咳咳。
sentences.translation: 「Ahem.

sentences.source: 再次欢迎……」
sentences.translation: Once again, welcome……」

sentences.source: 「抱歉，我在想事情，可不可以先不要说话？」
sentences.translation: 「Sorry, I’m trying to think, so could you please not talk for a moment？」

sentences.source: 「啊，好的。
sentences.translation: 「Ah, certainly.

sentences.source: 抱歉」
sentences.translation: My apologies」

sentences.source: 因为思考被声音打断了，我拜托他们稍等一下。
sentences.translation: Her voice had interrupted my thoughts, so I asked them to give me a moment.

sentences.source: 啊是这样啊，想起来了，这是最近刚刚读过的轻小说！
sentences.translation: Oh, that’s it—I remember now; this is just like a light novel I read recently！

sentences.source: 虽然不是什么值得宣扬的事情，我的爱好是世间所谓御宅的东西。
sentences.translation: It wasn’t exactly something to brag about, but my hobbies were what most people would call otaku stuff.

sentences.source: 只是个喜欢游戏，轻小说还算有兴趣，动画完全不看的半吊子…… 总之现在的状况和小说的展开很相似。
sentences.translation: I was only a half-baked otaku who liked games, had a passing interest in light novels, and never watched anime at all…… Anyway, this situation was unfolding just like a novel.

sentences.source: 因为勇者召唤来到异世界，和魔王战斗的王道故事，这种类型的小说想来还是见过不少。
sentences.translation: I had seen plenty of novels with the classic setup where someone is summoned to another world as a Hero and fights the Demon Lord.

sentences.source: 啊，不过，就算都叫异世界转移，也会有各种各样的展开。
sentences.translation: Ah, but even among isekai transfers, there were all sorts of different developments.

sentences.source: 有的是真的成为勇者和魔王战斗的，有的是实行召唤的王族才是坏人，还有是被召唤波及，被按上无能的烙印的一般人实际上有外挂之类的……
sentences.translation: Sometimes the summoned person really did become the Hero and fight the Demon Lord; sometimes the royal family behind the summoning were the real villains; and sometimes an ordinary person caught up in the summoning, branded as useless, secretly had cheat powers……
「…… Um, excuse me～」

sentences.source: 所以，现在需要的还是情报吧？
sentences.translation: So what I needed right now was information, right？

sentences.source: 就算有人说过「事实比小说更离奇」这种话，现阶段也不能确定这里就是异世界。
sentences.translation: People might say 「truth is stranger than fiction」, but at this stage I couldn’t even be sure this really was another world.

sentences.source: 现在明显是非日常的事态，总之要把握现状…… 哎？
sentences.translation: This was clearly an extraordinary situation, so first I needed to get a handle on what was going on…… Huh？

sentences.source: 好像忘掉了什么事情？
sentences.translation: Was I forgetting something？

sentences.source: 这时，我终于发现金发美女正在以困惑和担心的表情看着这里，意识一下子回到了现实。
sentences.translation: Only then did I finally notice the blonde beauty staring at me with a confused, worried expression, and my awareness snapped back to reality.

sentences.source: 这时候，我才想起自己打断了眼前的女性的话沉浸在思考之中。
sentences.translation: That was when I remembered that I had cut off the woman in front of me and retreated into my own thoughts.

sentences.source: 脸色慢慢发白。
sentences.translation: The blood slowly drained from my face.

sentences.source: 「…… 我觉得差不多该把话说下去了…… 可以了吗？」
sentences.translation: 「…… I believe it’s about time I continued…… May I？」

sentences.source: 「抱歉！！
sentences.translation: 「I’m sorry！！

sentences.source: 我老是一想事情就忘了周围的人……」
sentences.translation: Whenever I start thinking, I tend to forget everyone around me……」

sentences.source: 听到这有点踌躇的声音，我慌忙低下头。
sentences.translation: Hearing her hesitant voice, I hurriedly bowed my head.

sentences.source: 惨了…… 这个坏习惯又出来了。
sentences.translation: Crap…… That bad habit of mine had surfaced again.

sentences.source: 从很久之前开始，我就有专注于一件事情之后看不到周围的坏习惯。
sentences.translation: For as long as I could remember, I had a bad habit of losing sight of everything around me whenever I focused on one thing.

sentences.source: 说好听点叫集中力高，说难听点叫视野狭窄。
sentences.translation: To put it kindly, I had excellent concentration; to put it bluntly, I had tunnel vision.

sentences.source: 不管怎么说，我又搞砸了。
sentences.translation: Either way, I had screwed up again.

sentences.source: 两名女高中生看这里的眼神里有点无语的感觉，美女周围穿着长袍的人们好像也在苦笑似的。
sentences.translation: The two high school girls were giving me slightly exasperated looks, and the robed people around the beauty seemed to be smiling wryly as well.

sentences.source: 男高中生…… 脸朝着下面嘀咕着不知道什么话…… 啊，和这家伙大概能成为朋友。
sentences.translation: The high school boy…… was looking down and muttering something under his breath…… Ah, I could probably be friends with this guy.

sentences.source: 「不，事发突然，混乱也在所难免。
sentences.translation: 「No, this was all very sudden, so your confusion is perfectly understandable.

sentences.source: 我再次欢迎异世界的各位来到『新法尼亚王国』」
sentences.translation: Once again, I welcome all of you from another world to the 『Kingdom of Symphonia』」

sentences.source: 听了我的道歉，美女露出柔和的微笑，提起裙子的下方优雅地低下了头。
sentences.translation: In response to my apology, the beauty gave me a gentle smile, lifted the hem of her dress, and bowed gracefully.

sentences.source: 之后，差不多就是和预想一样，说了什么异世界的王国。
sentences.translation: Then, just as I had expected, she said something about a kingdom in another world.

sentences.source: 嗯～这种有气质的感觉，而且刚才还被称呼成大小姐…… 是贵族？
sentences.translation: Hmm～ With that air of refinement, plus the fact that she had just been called Ojō-sama…… was she a noble？

sentences.source: 说不定还是公主。
sentences.translation: She might even be a princess.

sentences.source: 「我是莉莉亚・阿尔伯特。
sentences.translation: 「I am Lilia Albert.

sentences.source: 对于突然的召唤我们非常抱歉。
sentences.translation: Please accept our deepest apologies for summoning you so suddenly.

sentences.source: 事发突然，你们想必有所困惑。
sentences.translation: Given how abruptly this happened, I am certain you must be confused.

sentences.source: 我们会先说明情况…… 不过在此之前，能不能先问一下各位的名字？」
sentences.translation: We will begin by explaining the situation…… but before that, may I ask each of your names？」
「…… Ah, of course.

sentences.source: 嗯…… 我是宫间快人」
sentences.translation: Um…… I’m Kaito Miyama」

sentences.source: 作为年长者，我先回答了美女…… 刚刚报上莉莉亚这个名字的女性的问题。
sentences.translation: As the oldest, I answered the beauty’s…… or rather, the woman who had just introduced herself as Lilia’s question first.

sentences.source: 如果是小说的话，这里通常会有暴走反抗、错乱大吼的人…… 然而实际经历的时候，因为混乱和困惑太大，反而可以冷静地回答。
sentences.translation: In a novel, this would usually be where someone flew into a rage, resisted, or screamed in panic…… Yet actually experiencing it left me so overwhelmed and bewildered that I was strangely able to answer calmly.

sentences.source: 「…… 我是楠葵」
sentences.translation: 「…… I’m Aoi Kusunoki」

sentences.source: 「…… 我是柚木阳菜」
sentences.translation: 「…… I’m Hina Yuzuki」

sentences.source: 「…… 我是光永正义」
sentences.translation: 「…… I’m Seigi Mitsunaga」

sentences.source: 高中生三人也跟着我报上了姓名。
sentences.translation: The three high schoolers followed my lead and gave their names.

sentences.source: 话说男高中生的名字好帅啊。
sentences.translation: On another note, that high school boy had one seriously cool name.

sentences.source: 你当勇者就好了吧。
sentences.translation: You might as well be the Hero.

sentences.source: 正义，好像就是为了当勇者才诞生的人的名字…… 不过他戴着眼镜，外表看上去倒是更像一个文科生就是了。
sentences.translation: Seigi—Justice—it was like he had been born to become a Hero…… Though with his glasses, he looked more like the bookish type.

sentences.source: 「是宫间先生、楠小姐、柚木小姐和光永先生对吧，请多多指教。
sentences.translation: 「Mr. Miyama, Miss Kusunoki, Miss Yuzuki, and Mr. Mitsunaga, correct？ It is a pleasure to meet you.

sentences.source: 不好意思，请再稍微等一下」
sentences.translation: My apologies, but please wait just a moment longer」

sentences.source: 说着，莉莉亚向着另一个穿着长袍的人使了个眼神。
sentences.translation: With that, Lilia shot a glance at another robed person.

sentences.source: 那个人拿出了个水晶球一样的东西。
sentences.translation: That person produced something resembling a crystal ball.

sentences.source: 我看到她们这个好像要做什么的行动，不禁身体僵硬了起来。
sentences.translation: Seeing them prepare to do something made my body tense involuntarily.

sentences.source: 莉莉亚慌忙地辨明说「没问题的，不会对你们有危害」。
sentences.translation: Lilia hurriedly reassured us, saying, 「It’s all right; this will not harm you」.

sentences.source: 擅自行动不像是好主意，我选择留在原地。
sentences.translation: Acting on my own didn’t seem wise, so I chose to stay where I was.

sentences.source: 「…… 看来光永殿下是作为勇者被召唤了。
sentences.translation: 「…… It appears Mitsunaga-sama was summoned as the Hero.

sentences.source: 其他人都是被波及的吧。」
sentences.translation: The rest of you must have been caught up in the summoning。」

sentences.source: 「果然是这样吗」
sentences.translation: 「So that is indeed what happened」

sentences.source: 看来勇者是光永正义君。
sentences.translation: Apparently, the Hero was Seigi Mitsunaga.

sentences.source: 要说预想猜对了是猜对了，不过这到底是要发生什么啊？
sentences.translation: So my prediction had technically been right, but what exactly was going to happen now？

sentences.source: 在这个什么都不知道的状况下，突然被说是勇者之后摆出了个小小的 pose 的光永君真是厉害。
sentences.translation: Mitsunaga was honestly impressive for striking a little pose after suddenly being told he was the Hero when none of us knew what was going on.

sentences.source: 你就是 No.1，去努力搞定麻烦事之类的玩意儿吧。
sentences.translation: You’re No. 1—go do your best and take care of all the troublesome stuff for us.

sentences.source: 「那么，对勇者的说明就交给你了？」
sentences.translation: 「In that case, shall I leave the explanation for the Hero to you？」

sentences.source: 「嗯，就这样吧。
sentences.translation: 「Yes, let us do that.

sentences.source: 莉莉亚大小姐就请对被波及的三个人说明吧」
sentences.translation: Lilia Ojō-sama, please explain matters to the three who were caught up in the summoning」

sentences.source: 听到这样的对话之后，莉莉亚告诉我们，对光永──勇者──的情况说明的内容和这边有所区别，所以会分开进行。
sentences.translation: After that exchange, Lilia told us that the explanation for Mitsunaga──the Hero──would differ from ours, so it would be given separately.

sentences.source: 「稍等一下。
sentences.translation: 「Wait a moment.

sentences.source: 为什么只有光永君是分开的？」
sentences.translation: Why is Mitsunaga the only one being separated from us？」

sentences.source: 「你们打算对正义做什么？」
sentences.translation: 「What are you planning to do to Seigi？」

sentences.source: 这一点还是反驳了──反驳的是楠和柚木……
sentences.translation: Someone did object to that──namely, Kusunoki and Yuzuki……

sentences.source: 对我来说，眼下最重要的问题是…… 在眼前安抚楠和柚木的莉莉亚。
sentences.translation: As far as I was concerned, the most important question right now was…… Lilia, who was currently trying to calm Kusunoki and Yuzuki.

sentences.source: 她是怎样的人物，打算对我们做什么。
sentences.translation: Who was she, and what did she intend to do with us？

sentences.source: 虽然说把一切都和轻小说的展开对照是不对的，不过这种故事的套路都是执行勇者召唤的王族把勇者当奴隶使唤，冷遇勇者以外的人。
sentences.translation: I knew it was wrong to compare everything to light-novel plots, but stories like this often had the royal family behind the Hero summoning treat the Hero like a slave and everyone else like dirt.

sentences.source: 事实上，现在她也说要把勇者光永君和我们分开说明，必然会让人猜疑有没有什么阴谋打算。
sentences.translation: And now she had said they would separate the Hero, Mitsunaga, from us for his explanation, which naturally made me suspect some sort of scheme.

sentences.source: 「我理解你们不安的心情。
sentences.translation: 「I understand why you feel uneasy.

sentences.source: 不过，我发誓绝对不会对你们施加危害。
sentences.translation: However, I swear that no harm whatsoever will come to you.

sentences.source: 这种举动是因为我们这边的原因，希望你们可以理解我们的任性。」
sentences.translation: This arrangement is necessary for reasons on our side, and I hope you can forgive our selfish request。」

sentences.source: 莉莉亚说完深深地低下了头。
sentences.translation: After saying that, Lilia bowed deeply.

sentences.source: 其他三人看到这个似乎在异世界也代表谢罪的行为，虽然看上去还没有完全接受，不过楠和柚木也不再反驳下去，光永君静静点头答应。
sentences.translation: The other three recognized that this gesture apparently signified an apology even in another world; though they did not look entirely convinced, Kusunoki and Yuzuki stopped objecting, while Mitsunaga quietly nodded his assent.

sentences.source: 当然我也点头答应了。
sentences.translation: Naturally, I nodded as well.

sentences.source: 其他三人应该也了解现在的状况，抵抗大概是没有意义的吧。
sentences.translation: The other three probably understood the situation too—resisting would likely be pointless.

sentences.source: 大概望一眼，就能看到穿着长袍的人有我们人数的两倍以上。
sentences.translation: A quick glance showed more than twice as many robed people as there were of us.

sentences.source: 如果全面相信她说的话的话，这里是异世界…… 肯定有什么魔法一样的能力。
sentences.translation: If I took her words at face value, this was another world…… which meant they surely had abilities like magic.

sentences.source: 被称作勇者的光永君可能有什么特别的能力，但只是被波及的我想必不会有这种东西。
sentences.translation: Mitsunaga, the one called the Hero, might possess some special power, but there was no reason to think someone merely caught up in the summoning like me would have anything of the sort.

sentences.source: 于是，在这里为了自保，只能选择听对方说明了。
sentences.translation: So, for my own safety, my only choice was to hear them out.

sentences.source: 莉莉亚带着我们走出了昏暗的地下室一样的地方，到达了内装豪华的大厅。
sentences.translation: Lilia led us out of the dim, basement-like chamber and into a lavishly furnished hall.

sentences.source: 勇者光永君的情况说明似乎是会在这边进行，他和一些穿着让人联想到圣职者的白衣服的人们一起留在这个房间，我和剩下的两个女生被带领到了另一间房间。
sentences.translation: It seemed the Hero Mitsunaga would receive his explanation there, so he remained in the room with several people in white garments reminiscent of clergy, while the two girls and I were led to another room.

sentences.source: 这间房间不到刚才大厅的一半大，但也足够宽敞。
sentences.translation: This room was less than half the size of the hall we had just left, but it was still spacious enough.

sentences.source: 里面的装饰是中世纪的风格，摆着一张大的长方形桌子和椅子…… 到此为止还没有什么异世界的氛围，并没有什么来到别的世界的实感。
sentences.translation: It was decorated in a medieval style, with a large rectangular table and chairs…… So far, though, there was nothing particularly otherworldly about it, and I still didn’t feel as though I had actually come to another world.

sentences.source: 「请随意就座。
sentences.translation: 「Please, take any seat you like.

sentences.source: 露娜，给这三位上点茶水。」
sentences.translation: Luna, serve our three guests some tea。」

sentences.source: 「遵命」
sentences.translation: 「At once」

sentences.source: 莉莉亚一边催促我们就座，一边向旁边不知道什么时候脱下长袍穿着女仆装的名叫露娜的女性做出指示。
sentences.translation: As Lilia urged us to sit, she gave instructions to the woman named Luna beside her, who had somehow shed her robe and changed into a maid uniform without me noticing.

sentences.source: 之前在昏暗的房间，露娜戴着连着头巾的长袍所以没注意到，露娜的头发是美丽的水蓝色…… 啊，异世界感来了。
sentences.translation: I hadn’t noticed in the dim room because Luna’s robe had a hood attached, but her hair was a beautiful aqua blue…… Ah, there was that otherworldly feeling.

sentences.source: 看到露娜行礼走出房间，我们小心翼翼地拉出椅子。
sentences.translation: After watching Luna bow and leave the room, we cautiously pulled out our chairs.

sentences.source: 我第一个坐到了莉莉亚正对面…… 稍微偏右一些的位置，楠和柚木与我空出两个座位的距离坐下了。
sentences.translation: I sat down first, in the seat directly across from Lilia…… or rather, slightly to her right, while Kusunoki and Yuzuki sat two seats away from me.

sentences.source: 少许之后，露娜推着载着红茶的小车回到房间，在我们面前放下茶杯，绕到了莉莉亚身后。
sentences.translation: A short while later, Luna returned pushing a cart laden with black tea, placed a cup before each of us, and moved around to stand behind Lilia.

sentences.source: 莉莉亚见状点了点头，用温和的语气开始了说明。
sentences.translation: Seeing that, Lilia nodded and began her explanation in a gentle tone.

sentences.source: 「首先请让我再次谢罪。
sentences.translation: 「First, please allow me to apologize once more.

sentences.source: 突然把你们叫到另一个世界，还因为我们的原因，花了这么久才能开始说明，真的很抱歉。」
sentences.translation: I am truly sorry for suddenly bringing you to another world and, due to circumstances on our side, taking so long to begin explaining everything。」
「Ah, no……」

sentences.source: 「那个，我们到底…… 会怎么样？」
sentences.translation: 「Um, what exactly…… is going to happen to us？」

sentences.source: 问出我最关心的问题的是楠。
sentences.translation: It was Kusunoki who asked the question that concerned me most.

sentences.source: 长着一头细长有光泽的黑发，她和我相比看上去更加冷静。
sentences.translation: With her long, glossy black hair, she appeared far calmer than I was.

sentences.source: 她肯定是坚强的女性吧，这和我是胆小鬼这种事情没什么关系。
sentences.translation: She must have been a strong young woman—and that had absolutely nothing to do with me being a coward.

sentences.source: 「作为大前提，我以『阿尔伯特公爵家』的家名发誓，我们不会对包括光永先生的你们四人做出任何危害」
sentences.translation: 「First and foremost, I swear upon the name of 『House Albert』 that no harm will come to any of you four, including Mr. Mitsunaga」

sentences.source: 「…… 阿尔伯特…… 公爵家？」
sentences.translation: 「…… Albert…… a ducal house？」

sentences.source: 「啊，失礼了。
sentences.translation: 「Ah, forgive me.

sentences.source: 我应该先说明我的立场的。
sentences.translation: I should have explained my position first.

sentences.source: 我的名字是莉莉亚・阿尔伯特，是新法尼亚王国中持有公爵爵位的贵族」
sentences.translation: My name is Lilia Albert, and I am a noble who holds the title of duke in the Kingdom of Symphonia」

sentences.source: 「莉莉亚小姐是现任国王陛下同父异母的妹妹，除了爵位之外还有第四位王位继承权。
sentences.translation: 「Lady Lilia is the current king’s younger half-sister on his father’s side, and in addition to her title, she is fourth in line to the throne.

sentences.source: 因此，大小姐以家名做出的宣誓，可以当作国家的意志来接受也没有问题」
sentences.translation: Therefore, you may safely regard Ojō-sama’s oath upon her family name as the will of the nation itself」

sentences.source: 公爵！？
sentences.translation: A duke！？

sentences.source: 王位继承权！？
sentences.translation: In line for the throne！？

sentences.source: 和预想一样还真是高贵的大人物。
sentences.translation: Just as I had suspected, she really was an incredibly high-ranking person.

sentences.source: 「顺带一提年龄是二十二岁，在通常十五到十九岁结婚的新法尼亚王国里是少见的单身公爵。」
sentences.translation: 「Incidentally, she is twenty-two years old and, in the Kingdom of Symphonia, where people usually marry between fifteen and nineteen, is the rare unmarried duke。」
「…… Luna？

sentences.source: 为什么要补充这一条？
sentences.translation: Why did you feel the need to add that？

sentences.source: 现在根本不需要这条资讯吧？」
sentences.translation: That information was completely unnecessary right now, wasn’t it？」

sentences.source: 「不，我觉得『大小姐』这个称呼已经快要不合适了……」
sentences.translation: 「No, I simply feel that addressing you as 『Ojō-sama』 is rapidly becoming inappropriate……」

sentences.source: 「…… 之后有话要和你说说」
sentences.translation: 「…… You and I are going to have a little talk later」

sentences.source: 怎么回事。
sentences.translation: What was going on here？

sentences.source: 明明莉莉亚看上去高贵美丽，行为和语气都很礼貌优雅…… 周围飘荡的残念的感觉…… 而且露娜真是毫不留情。
sentences.translation: Lilia looked noble and beautiful, and both her manner and speech were refined and elegant…… yet there was this faintly disappointing air hanging around her…… And Luna really pulled no punches.

sentences.source: 「…… 回到刚刚的话题，让我继续回答刚才楠的疑问。
sentences.translation: 「…… Returning to the matter at hand, allow me to continue answering Miss Kusunoki’s question.

sentences.source: 您最感到不安的大概是能否回到原来的世界这一点吧。
sentences.translation: Your greatest concern is most likely whether you can return to your original world.

sentences.source: 请你务必放心」
sentences.translation: Please rest assured」

sentences.source: 「能回去吗……？」
sentences.translation: 「We can go back……？」

sentences.source: 带着若干胆怯的声音回问的，是栗色短发散发出小动物般的可爱的柚木。
sentences.translation: The one who asked back in a somewhat timid voice was Yuzuki, whose short chestnut hair gave her the cuteness of a small animal.

sentences.source: 从楠轻轻地握着她的手这一举动上，以及柚木的小个头上，可以推测出两人是学姐学妹的关系。
sentences.translation: From the way Kusunoki gently held her hand, along with Yuzuki’s small stature, I guessed the two had a senpai-kōhai relationship.

sentences.source: 不过胸是柚木更加…… 不不，我在想什么啊！？
sentences.translation: Though Yuzuki was more developed in the chest…… No, no, what am I thinking！？

sentences.source: 「嗯…… 只是那个……」
sentences.translation: 「Yes…… It is just that……」

sentences.source: 听到柚木的提问，莉莉亚有点面带难色。
sentences.translation: At Yuzuki’s question, a troubled look crossed Lilia’s face.

sentences.source: 果然是那样子么？
sentences.translation: So that was how it was after all？

sentences.source: 有个叫魔王之类的家伙，不打倒他们就没法归还之类的。
sentences.translation: There was some Demon Lord we had to defeat before we could go home, or something like that.

sentences.source: 如果这样的话，果然莉莉亚的话不能按照字面意思理解……
sentences.translation: If so, then I really couldn’t take Lilia’s words at face value……

sentences.source: 「距离魔法阵可以再次使用…… 要等一年的时间」
sentences.translation: 「It will be one year…… before the magic circle can be used again」
「O-One year！？」

sentences.source: 哎？
sentences.translation: Huh？

sentences.source: 感觉和预想的有一点点不一样。
sentences.translation: That was just a little different from what I had expected.

sentences.source: 楠的尖叫恐怕是对一年这个时间长度感到吃惊，我则是在另一种意义上吃惊。
sentences.translation: Kusunoki had probably cried out because a year sounded so long, while I was surprised for an entirely different reason.

sentences.source: 没错，条件实在是太轻松了……
sentences.translation: That’s right—the condition was far too easy……

sentences.source: 这种展开一般不都是不打倒魔王没法回去吗？
sentences.translation: In this kind of story, weren’t you usually unable to return until you defeated the Demon Lord？

sentences.source: 啊，说不定光永君就是这样。
sentences.translation: Ah, maybe that only applied to Mitsunaga.

sentences.source: 如果是这种情况的话，只有他的说明不一样也可以理解。
sentences.translation: If that were the case, it would explain why only his briefing was different.

sentences.source: 而且就算条件很轻松，在原来的世界一年之间都是神隐状态。
sentences.translation: And even if the condition itself was easy, we would still be missing from our original world for an entire year.

sentences.source: 考虑到这一点对原来世界的影响，也不是能随意接受的。
sentences.translation: Considering the consequences that would have back home, it wasn’t something we could casually accept.

sentences.source: 「…… 怎么这样，这次的大会我是五千米跑的代表啊……」
sentences.translation: 「…… No way, I’m supposed to represent our team in the five-thousand-meter race at the next meet……」

sentences.source: 「阳菜，问题不是那里……」
sentences.translation: 「Hina, that’s not the issue here……」

sentences.source: 柚木是天然属性吗？
sentences.translation: Was Yuzuki an airhead？

sentences.source: 在这种状况下担心社团的大会，已经是让人佩服的等级了。
sentences.translation: Worrying about a club meet in a situation like this was honestly impressive.

sentences.source: 「啊，请放心。
sentences.translation: 「Ah, please do not worry.

sentences.source: 按照『女神』的说法，这边的世界和你们的世界时间流速不一样，在送还的时候，会回到召唤后的那一瞬间。
sentences.translation: According to the 『Goddess』, time flows differently in this world and yours, so when you are sent back, you will return to the instant immediately after the summoning.

sentences.source: 一年里成长的身体也会让女神变回去的，这一点也没有问题」
sentences.translation: The Goddess will also restore your bodies to how they were before that year of growth, so there is no cause for concern there either」

sentences.source: 不安的问题迅速得到解决，结果马上又出来个女神这种新的不明要素。
sentences.translation: The issue worrying us had been resolved in an instant, only for a new unknown factor called the Goddess to appear.

sentences.source: 嗯，总而言之，返回原来的世界还需要一年。
sentences.translation: Well, in short, it would still take a year before we could return to our original world.

sentences.source: 不过并不需要担心那边的时间流逝，而且即使在这边的世界长得非常胖，也会有个什么女神来变回去……
sentences.translation: But we didn’t need to worry about time passing there, and even if we got incredibly fat in this world, some Goddess or other would change us back……

sentences.source: 「当然，三位在这边的人身安全和衣食住都由我们保证。
sentences.translation: 「Naturally, we will guarantee the personal safety, food, clothing, and lodging of all three of you during your stay here.

sentences.source: 虽然做不到奢侈豪华，但是我会负责让你们过上自由方便的生活」
sentences.translation: Although I cannot promise extravagance, I will personally ensure that you can live freely and comfortably」
「…… Whew, hah……」

sentences.source: 「啊，谢谢」
sentences.translation: 「Ah, thank you」

sentences.source: 因为连续放出对我方有利的情报，楠和柚木都有点困惑，甚至有一些失神发呆，以至于不经过大脑思考就表达感谢……
sentences.translation: With one reassuring revelation after another coming our way, Kusunoki and Yuzuki looked confused and even a little dazed, thanking her before they had time to think……

sentences.source: 然而还不能大意。
sentences.translation: Still, I couldn’t let my guard down yet.

sentences.source: 光永君的事情还没解决。
sentences.translation: The matter of Mitsunaga remained unresolved.

sentences.source: 如果勇者是为了和魔王战斗召唤过来的话，也就说明这个世界有与之相应的危险。
sentences.translation: If the Hero had been summoned to fight a Demon Lord, then this world must contain dangers to match.

sentences.source: 「…… 我可以提问吗？」
sentences.translation: 「…… May I ask a question？」

sentences.source: 「当然了，宫间先生」
sentences.translation: 「Of course, Mr. Miyama」

sentences.source: 「嗯，在另一间房间接受说明的…… 光永君对吧。
sentences.translation: 「Um, the one receiving an explanation in the other room…… that’s Mitsunaga, correct？

sentences.source: 他被称呼为勇者，是不是说有魔王之类的存在，要和他去战斗呢？」
sentences.translation: Since you called him the Hero, does that mean some Demon Lord or the like exists and he has to fight it？」

sentences.source: 我下定决心问出口了。
sentences.translation: I steeled myself and asked.

sentences.source: 这里应该会是转捩点。
sentences.translation: This would be the turning point.

sentences.source: 莉莉亚是会正直地说明还是蒙混过关，我会根据她的行为来一定程度上确定自己对将来生活的方针。
sentences.translation: Whether Lilia answered honestly or tried to dodge the question would go a long way toward determining how I approached my life here from now on.

sentences.source: 那么，你会怎么出招？
sentences.translation: So, what move would you make？

sentences.source: 我的内心砰砰地跳，问出了刚才的问题。
sentences.translation: My heart pounded as I posed the question.

sentences.source: 莉莉亚和露娜同时…… 露出了吃惊和疑问的表情。
sentences.translation: At the same time, Lilia and Luna…… both looked surprised and puzzled.

sentences.source: 「魔王，吗？
sentences.translation: 「A Demon Lord, you say？

sentences.source: 大概一千年之前已经被初代勇者打倒了哦」
sentences.translation: The first Hero defeated him about a thousand years ago」
「…… Huh？

sentences.source: 那魔族什么的和人类是敌对关系吗？」
sentences.translation: Then are demons and humans enemies？」

sentences.source: 「没有，人类和魔族是非常良好的关系。
sentences.translation: 「No, humans and demons enjoy a very good relationship.

sentences.source: 交流和贸易都很繁荣」
sentences.translation: Cultural exchange and trade between them are both thriving」

sentences.source: 「…… 战争之类的呢？」
sentences.translation: 「…… What about wars？」

sentences.source: 「就我所知，最近八百年左右都没有发生」
sentences.translation: 「As far as I know, none have occurred in roughly eight hundred years」

sentences.source: 「…… 那有没有到处遍布的魔物之类的？」
sentences.translation: 「…… Then are there monsters running rampant everywhere or anything like that？」

sentences.source: 「魔物是存在的，不过讨伐是冒险者工会和骑士团的工作，不需要光永先生和你们去奔赴战场」
sentences.translation: 「Monsters do exist, but subjugating them is the responsibility of the Adventurers’ Guild and the knight orders; neither Mr. Mitsunaga nor any of you will be asked to go to the battlefield」

sentences.source: 哎？
sentences.translation: Huh？

sentences.source: 这对话是什么情况？
sentences.translation: What was going on with this conversation？

sentences.source: 等等，求求你给我点时间思考！
sentences.translation: Wait, please, just give me a moment to think！

sentences.source: 嗯，魔王不存在？
sentences.translation: Okay, so there was no Demon Lord？

sentences.source: 和魔族的关系良好？
sentences.translation: Relations with the demons were good？

sentences.source: 战争已经八百年没有发生了？
sentences.translation: There hadn’t been a war in eight hundred years？

sentences.source: 有魔物但不需要我们去处理？
sentences.translation: Monsters existed, but we didn’t have to deal with them？

sentences.source: 「…… 那勇者召唤是为了什么？」
sentences.translation: 「…… Then what is the Hero summoning for？」

sentences.source: 「千年前，准确的说是 1009 年前，初代勇者殿下打败了魔王，成为让魔族和人类携手合作的桥梁。
sentences.translation: 「A thousand years ago—1,009 years ago, to be precise—the first Yūsha-sama defeated the Demon Lord and became the bridge that brought demons and humans together.

sentences.source: 为了称颂那份功绩、祈愿今后的和平，十年一度会从初代勇者同一个异世界召唤勇者，举行盛大的庆典。
sentences.translation: To honor that achievement and pray for peace in the years ahead, once every ten years we summon a Hero from the same other world as the first Hero and hold a grand festival.

sentences.source: 另外，勇者召唤的负责人是各国贵族轮流担当，今年轮到了我」
sentences.translation: Responsibility for the Hero summoning rotates among the nobles of each nation, and this year it fell to me」
「…… A festival？」

sentences.source: 「是的。
sentences.translation: 「That is correct.

sentences.source: 因此光永先生要成为恰好一年以后的『勇者祭』的主角，需要参加仪式和访问各国，现在正在其他房间接受相关的说明。
sentences.translation: Mr. Mitsunaga is therefore to be the central figure of the 『Hero Festival』 exactly one year from now, which will require him to attend ceremonies and visit the various nations, and he is currently receiving an explanation of those duties in the other room.

sentences.source: 当然，我们会尊重他本人的意志，要辞退也是可以的」
sentences.translation: Naturally, we will respect his wishes, and he is free to decline」

sentences.source: 「啊，还可以辞退啊」
sentences.translation: 「Oh, he can turn it down」

sentences.source: 「没错，过去有几例让勇者代理举办勇者祭的。
sentences.translation: 「Indeed; there have been several occasions in the past when a stand-in Hero presided over the Hero Festival.

sentences.source: 在勇者接受的情况下，到勇者祭之间的这一年之间享受国宾的超高待遇。
sentences.translation: If the Hero accepts, he will receive extraordinarily generous treatment as a state guest during the year leading up to the Hero Festival.

sentences.source: 辞退的情况下，也会保证他的生活，在这个世界观光一年之后送还回去」
sentences.translation: If he declines, we will still provide for him, and after a year of sightseeing in this world, he will be sent home」

sentences.source: 「…… 嗯，所以说…… 关于我们的未来……」
sentences.translation: 「…… Um, so then…… as for what happens to us……」

sentences.source: 「嗯…… 虽然你可能还会有点困惑，不过请你充分享受这个不同文化的世界，多多交流观光，体验这个世界十年一度的祭典之后…… 安全返回原来的世界」
sentences.translation: 「Yes…… You may still be somewhat confused, but please enjoy this world and its different culture to the fullest, socialize and sightsee as much as you like, experience its once-in-a-decade festival, and then…… return safely to your original world」

sentences.source: 拜启，母亲，父亲──我被卷入了异世界召唤。
sentences.translation: Dear Mom and Dad──I got caught up in a summoning to another world.

sentences.source: 但是，世界──很和平。
sentences.translation: But the other world──was at peace.
